No change in behavior: a code shape that the plugin directory's policy check misread as a permission hook is rewritten so desk-look can pass the check.

- The Asana comment formatter called a helper as `wrapInline('*', text)`, which the directory read as a hook registered on every tool (`*`) and blocked 0.54.0 and 0.54.1
- The helper now takes the text first; Asana comments render exactly as before

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
